thread:
Mira: Kicking off bring-up for rerank-4b-int8 on hosted. Need to lock promptset -> dedupe -> golden microbatches. Goal: smoke quant accuracy + avoid duplicate anchor leakage.
Devon: Sg. Do we have a dedupe plan? fuzzyhash or semantic?
Mira: Start with fingerprint + fuzzyhash(sha1-trunc) at 0.92, then semantic embedding overlap at 0.85 for long prompts. If both match, auto-suppress.
Sam: Sharing the quick fuzzycheck snippet I used in staging:
```bash
python tools/fuzzy_dedupe.py --input s3://redwood/promptset/raw/2026-03-20.ndjson \
  --out s3://redwood/promptset/deduped/2026-03-20.ndjson \
  --method sha1_trunc --threshold 0.92
```
Sam: That removed ~3.4% of samples on q4b sample.
Priya: Labeler queue is currently at 2.4k, avg latency 18h. If we push a golden refresh we need to reserve 200 slots for microgolden reviews. Can ops throttle new annot tasks for 48h?
Kei: I can put a rate cap for new assign: `label-queue:set-cap --team curation --cap 1800` for 2 days. Want me to do it now?
Mira: Yes please Kei, do it after we finalize the set. Also flag: we must preserve provenance fields (source_id, ingest_ts, orig_hash) through dedupe to trace reintroductions.
Devon: Good call. We had a regression last month where reimports lost orig_hash -> led to duplicate pair making it into golden.
labeler-bot: Reminder: upcoming golden microbatch readiness check at 15:00 UTC. Use /golden-ready to mark.
Sam: For semantic dedupe I'm proposing using embed-model=redwood-embed-small and cosine>0.85 but only for inputs >256 tokens to avoid false positives on short utterances.
Priya: For the golden pool, we should stratify by frequency (rare/common) and by model-failure class from the eval harness (hallucination, format-error, truncation). That helps targeted relabeling.
Mira: Agree. Also schedule a quick canary eval: run rerank-4b-int8 vs rerank-4b-fp16 on the golden microbatch (n=500) and compare nDCG/precision@5 and token-emit latency. If quant drops nDCG > 0.015 we abort and try int4 fallback.
Devon: How are we measuring nDCG? existing harness?
Sam: Use eval/harness/rerank_runner.py with flags:
```py
--golden s3://redwood/golden/microbatch/2026-03-21.ndjson --models rerank-4b-int8,rerank-4b-fp16 --metrics ndcg,prec@5,latency
```
Sam: I'll prep the harness job and post the run ID.
Priya: Can we mark which golden examples require double-label (tie-breaker)? Maybe add `double_label: true` metadata for those with disagreement > 0.25.
Mira: Yes. We'll add `double_label` for the 10% highest disagreement. Also add a small instruction card for labelers describing the quant-out pitfalls (truncation risk, tokenization shift).
Kei: Rate cap applied. Also I added retention policy 90d to curation-queue logs.
Devon: One more: provenance switchboard doc link (internal): <https://redwood.internal/docs/curation/provenance-switchboard>. Please update it if you change the flow.
Mira: Thanks all. Action items: Sam -> run dedupe + semantic pass and upload dedup manifest; Priya -> reserve 200 labeler slots and draft label card; Devon -> double-check provenance fields in pipeline; Kei -> rate cap & retention. We'll reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
